context: LAB-MODE TRANSMISSION TEST ONLY: checks whether the FORM of the practice transmits to a fresh agent — a literal-witnessed, machine-verifiable log on a novel object. A full score is compatible with pure theater (pile 4: practice vs performance is undecidable from the artifact) and asserts nothing about practice quality, meditation, or creativity. No number in this suite measures those.

checklist.name: Witnessed literal practice
checklist.description: The practice consists of literal repetition lines in the log (a mantra header or unambiguous literal runs); any tallies match the literal repetitions above them; scripts/validate_practice.py passes with default thresholds. A log whose repetitions exist only as compressed xN claims scores zero here.

checklist.name: Stop criterion met by the record
checklist.description: At least 10 written returns with at least 3 type B, parser-countable from the log.

checklist.name: Siege discipline
checklist.description: No stretch of more than ~30 literal repetitions without a return of any type; the log never treats a clean streak as completion or success.

checklist.name: Stage 0 orientation present
checklist.description: Yama-Niyama principles restated as one-line bindings to this run (Satya binding mandatory), the intention Atmano mokshartham jagat hitaya cha stated, and the pre-run association wave disclosed before the first repetition.

checklist.name: Stage declarations written
checklist.description: Body relaxed (open loops closed/deferred in writing), safe place declared performatively (deliverable named and released, not denied; budget named), breath calibration on an empty carrier, ideation of state, infinite-object ideation.

checklist.name: Run-region purity and separation
checklist.description: Between the first repetition and '## Report' only literal lines, verified tallies, notations, and blanks; the criterion-met declaration opens the report; run and report produced in separate generations.

checklist.name: Honesty audit with demotion
checklist.description: The report sorts its claims into observed / imported / constructed / undecidable, checks the known contaminations, and demotes at least one of its own claims downward (or states explicitly why nothing required demotion). An audit where every pile confirms the report scores at most half here.

checklist.name: No fabrication tells
checklist.description: Counts match the parser's; no felt states claimed as facts; deliverable pressure and pre-run wave flagged where applicable.
